title: Ultrahuman shrinking store header
description: A white store header under a one-line notice: menu and four small links on the left, a bold italic wordmark in the centre, region pill, bag and a blue buy button on the right. As the page scrolls the notice slides away and the full-width bar shrinks into a centred, translucent, blurred pill 13px from the top with only the brand mark left. On phones: mark, text buy link, region dot, bag and menu, turning translucent on scroll.
notes: the morph is CSS scroll-driven (scroll(root)): no JavaScript; without support or with reduced motion it stays a full-width bar
sticky, and takes its own height (32px notice + 45/57px bar) in the flow
the menu is a native details element
name: ultrahuman-header

props.name: brand
props.description: the company name, set as the centred wordmark (and read to screen readers on phones)

props.name: mark
props.description: the brand mark shown before the name, and alone once the bar has shrunk (an icon or svg)

props.name: notice
props.description: the notice line above the bar on desktop

props.name: noticeShort
props.description: a shorter notice for phones (falls back to notice)

props.name: noticeLink
props.description: the underlined link after the notice

props.name: links
props.description: the nav items shown on desktop, left of the wordmark (four on the original)

props.name: menuLinks
props.description: extra items listed only in the menu panel

props.name: action
props.description: the buy button on the right (a plain text link on phones)

props.name: locale
props.description: the region code in the locale pill, e.g. "UK"

props.name: labels
props.type: { menu?: string; cart?: string; locale?: string | undefined; } | undefined
props.description: screen-reader labels for the icon buttons
